bullets.bullet_text: Led enterprise AWS modernization architecture across regulated financial-services portfolios, decomposing legacy workloads into microservices and sequencing cloud-native migration waves through reusable reference architecture.

Directed portfolio decision-support modernization by connecting HPC scenario analysis and analytics pipelines to executive workflows for financial institutions, turning model outputs into actionable operating decisions.

Led cross-functional technical discovery and pre-sales solution mapping for enterprise financial-services pursuits, translating buyer priorities into architecture-backed demonstrations and delivery-ready handoffs.

Owned enterprise portfolio solution leadership by building BI views and governed data models that connected modernization scope, budget assumptions, and delivery status to executive operating decisions.

Led cross-functional IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for enterprise financial-services modernization, aligning solution architecture, partner planning, and executive sponsorship to deliver 20% joint revenue growth.
